metadata.name: ViewBulkCardDetails
metadata.description: This API is to view details of created Bulk Card order.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Unique number of merchant account. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 12345 Condition: Either of one identifier is mandatory from: MerchantID, OrderID, BulkCardUUID, ProductID, StoreID

request_fields.name: OrderID
request_fields.description: Order ID of the Bulk card order Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 12345 Condition: Either of one identifier is mandatory from: MerchantID, OrderID, BulkCardUUID, ProductID, StoreID

request_fields.name: BulkCardUUID
request_fields.description: Unique number Bulk card order Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 12345 Condition: Either of one identifier is mandatory from: MerchantID, OrderID, BulkCardUUID, ProductID, StoreID Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: ID assigned to a Program Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: Fixed value provided by CoreCard. Condition: Either of one identifier is mandatory from: MerchantID, OrderID, BulkCardUUID, ProductID, StoreID

request_fields.name: StoreID
request_fields.description: Store ID Valid Values: XXX Format: 0-9 Example: 1234 Condition: Either of one identifier is mandatory from: MerchantID, OrderID, BulkCardUUID, ProductID, StoreID

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card Number of account holder Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 1236547896541236 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Debtor File # or Client Account # Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: 7314145404 Condition: At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: DeliveryMechanism
request_fields.description: Shipment delivery mechanism. By Default Setting must be for standard Delivery Valid Values: a-z Format: xxxx Example: (Overnight, Priority or Standard) Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: OderStatus
request_fields.description: It has values as Approval pending, Approved, Cards Created, Rejected. Valid Values: A-Z Format: XXXXXXXXX Example: Approval pending Allowable Values: 50

response_fields.name: BulkRequestDetails
response_fields.description: List of the following Bulk card tags

response_fields.name: ResponseID
response_fields.description: This number indicates that API responded.Response ID is unique.This value will be null if no authentication information was passed.Response ID can be used for tracking Valid Values: 0-9,a-z Format: xxx Example: 200

response_fields.name: CurrencySymbol
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the currency symbol

response_fields.name: CurrencySymbol
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the currency symbol

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.description: Card holder's address line 2. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: Park Avenue Allowable Values: 19

children.name: City
children.description: Debtor City Example: Los Angeles Condition: CBR Allowable Values: 19

children.name: PostalCode
children.description: Postal code of the card holder's address. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 46206 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: Country

children.name: State

children.name: StoreName

children.name: Title
children.description: Title of the cardholder Format: A-Z Example:Mr Allowable Values: 9

children.name: FirstName
children.description: Card holder's First name. Valid Values: A-Z Format: XXXXX Example: User1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: MiddleName
children.description: Card holder's Middle Name Valid Values: A-Z Format: XXX Example: LEE Allowable Values: 50

children.name: LastName
children.description: Card holder's last name. Valid Values: A-Z Format: XXXXX Example: Smith Allowable Values: 50

children.name: NameOnCard
children.description: Name to be printed on the card. Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: John J Allowable Values: 25

children.name: ApprovedBy
children.description: Approval person Name Valid Values: A-Z Format: XXX Example: LEE Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EmbossingLine4
children.description: Content on Embossing line4 Valid Values: A-Z Format: XXX Example: LEE Allowable Values: 26

children.name: InstitutionID
children.description: Unique identification number for Institution Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXX Example: Fixed value needs to pass which is provided by Corecard.
